acv.quote: About a hundred and forty K a year.

header.reason: Ines, the CFO, signed once Wen priced her manual deposit matching from her own statements. Dana first thought it was a portal deal, but the checkout pitch stalled for three weeks.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with a slow month-end close, not online checkout.

line.text: Stripe automates the tedious parts of revenue reporting and reconciliation, so teams spend less time closing the books

findings.why: A new CFO's first close took nine days. The portal Dana pitched was only the excuse.
findings.quote: her first month-end close took nine days

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Put the finance payoff on the first page of our pitch.
findings.why: Ines read only the first page of the portal proposal and stopped there.
findings.quote: she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Offer a named person who knows her business, not lower rates.

line.text: Premium support: a dedicated support manager who has ongoing context about your business

findings.why: Ines's bank rep had changed and the bank only offered rates. Dana never saw Fiserv's own pitch.
findings.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Swap the global growth opener for matching payouts to invoices.
findings.why: The standard deck got silence from a seller in three states. Wen's payout matching demo made Ines stop him.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a wholesale distributor customer story to our finance messaging.
findings.why: Ines asked twice to talk to a distributor and brushed off our retail case study.
findings.quote: this is a company that sells sweaters.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'where my money is' and 'deposits', not 'infrastructure'.

line.text: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue

findings.why: Ines never said payments or infrastructure. She talked about deposits and a week of archaeology.
findings.quote: I just want to know where my money is.
